title: Annotatio II §.V: Brentius & Jacob Andreae resume ubiquity — Heshusius contradicts though sharing Coena view
pass_a_gloss: but resumed by Brentius and Jacob Andreae (as we said in the preceding Annotation §. 14), Tillemann Heshusius nevertheless contradicting — although a sharer of the same opinion concerning the Supper (see Hospinian, Historia Sacramentaria, page 40) —
pass_b_english: Brentius and Jacob Andreae took it up again (as we noted in the preceding Annotation, §.14) — even though Tillemann Heshusius, who shared their Supper view, contradicted them (see Hospinian, Historia Sacramentaria, p. 40).
source_text: à Brentio verò & Jacobo Andrea (uti annot. precedenti §. 14. diximus) contradicente tamen ejusdem licèt sententiae de Coena participe Tillemanno Heshusio (videatur Hospin. Hist. Sacr. pag. 40.) reassumtam

lemmas.note: Lutheran Coena ally who opposed ubiquity resume

choices.english: sharer / participant in the same Coena opinion
choices.why: Heshusius agrees on Supper yet opposes ubiquity

notes: Hexades Annotatio II §.V densify section 185; OCR Jocobo→Jacobo, Heshufió→Heshusio; Pass A!=B; locked PDF ~244 / Hexades (64).
